fields.Notes:
MBA (Finance) [NCR-030]: Official 2026 admissions, criteria, fee and placement pages reviewed. The current seat matrix shows 70 seats; the official annual fee shown for 2024-25 is ₹48,500, so the existing two-year approximation remains labelled. | 16 Oct 2026 research: Rechecked official PDF final statistics. The report is separate from 2025–27 summer internships; those stipends were excluded. | Final audit: Historical school name: Department of Financial Studies, University of Delhi. The official 2026 Finance placement report describes the DFS/DBE merger, and the joint admission advertisement uses Department of Finance and Business Economics. Finance and Business Economics are programmes within one current department; their outcomes remain separate. Finance mean ₹15.5 L, median ₹15.25 L and highest ₹28.3 L are final placements, not 2025–27 summer internship stipends. The ₹48,500 annual fee is explicitly historical 2024–25; a current 2026–27 schedule was not located.

MBA (Business Economics) [NCR-031]: New report 2025-26 reports mean 15.20, median 14.20 and highest 30.25. Corroborated Careers 360; official department placement page remains a client-rendered page and text headline 14.47 is older. | Final audit: Historical school name: Department of Business Economics, University of Delhi. Now part of the Department of Finance and Business Economics following the merger described in the Finance placement report. The joint 2026–27 advertisement uses the current department name. The official Business Economics 2025–26 report supplies mean ₹15.2 L, median ₹14.2 L and highest ₹30.25 L. Keep these programme outcomes distinct from MBA Finance. Current Business Economics fees and seat matrix were not recovered in this audit.
